addons.name: Automations
addons.summary: The follow up that runs without you.
includes: Google review requests after each job

underneath.text: Automations know when to stop. The moment a customer replies or books, the sequence shuts off.
Review requests only go to customers whose job is finished, so you are asking people who are happy.
Opt outs are handled automatically on every text and email.
Hosting, SSL, backups and uptime monitoring are handled for you.
You own all of it. Domain, site, customer list, review history. Nothing is held hostage.
